li.label: humiliated by the council
li.description: They made an example of me in front of everyone. I won't forget whose idea that was.

li.label: forgiven
li.description: I messed up, and they let it go. I owe them for that.

li.label: the council let it slide
li.description: Somebody does wrong and gets a pat on the head. So much for rules.

li.label: the council was cruel
li.description: There was no need for that. People make mistakes. We're supposed to be better than this.

li.label: fair's fair
li.description: The council dealt with it properly. Good.

li.label: the council took my side
li.description: I was right, and now everyone knows it.

li.label: the council took their side
li.description: I brought it to the council and they sided against me. Fine. I know where I stand.

li.label: won the council over against me
li.description: They went running to the council, and the council listened to them.

li.label: worked it out
li.description: We were made to sort it out ourselves, and somehow we did.

li.label: forced to work with someone I can't stand
li.description: The council's idea of a solution: lock us in a room together. Brilliant.

li.label: the council wouldn't get involved
li.description: I asked for help and the council looked the other way.

li.label: a feast!
li.description: Everything good in the stores, all at once. My stomach is a happy stomach.

li.label: a little feast
li.description: Not a banquet, but a good meal and a good evening.

li.label: no feast
li.description: I wanted to cook something special for everyone. Apparently rice is special enough.

li.label: they understood
li.description: I told them I wasn't coping, and they listened. I didn't expect that.

li.label: told to pull myself together
li.description: I admitted I was struggling. They told me to get back to work.

li.label: helped someone through a bad time
li.description: Someone needed a friend, and I was there.

li.label: was there for me
li.description: When things were bad, they stayed with me.

li.label: someone's getting days off
li.description: We're all tired. Some of us still work.

li.label: shared the stash
li.description: Somebody's forgotten stash, and now it's ours. Cheers.

li.label: they locked up the good stuff
li.description: A whole stash, and it goes in a locked room for "trading". Sure.

li.label: they poured it out
li.description: Perfectly good stuff, poured into the dirt. I could weep.

li.label: the poison is gone
li.description: That stash would only have caused trouble. Good riddance.
